title: Aftershock hits Caracas as rescue efforts enter critical hours in Venezuela
summary: Residents of ​Caracas woke ‌up on Monday to an aftershock that rocked their ⁠houses, while rescue teams continued their fourth day of round-the-clock work in the areas affected by last week's powerful ‌earthquakes in Venezuela.
